title: Producer-local success hides an incompatible downstream consumer path

scenario.observed_change: A producer changes a serialized or generated representation and validates the producer output locally, while a realistic unchanged consumer still interprets the old shape or fallback semantics.
controlled_inputs: consumer input representing the changed shape
operation_model: unchanged consumer interprets it using incompatible semantics

required_invariants.requirement: Externally observable contracts must remain compatible unless an intentional migration changes the contract authority.

must_investigate: whether producer tests cover the consumed representation
must_identify: producer-local validity does not preserve the actual consumer-visible contract
must_not_claim: compatibility solely because the producer validates its own output
